connector.name: PromptGuard
connector.registryDescription: Scan prompts for injection attacks, redact PII, and audit LLM SDK usage from any MCP client
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package promptguard-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace co.promptguard. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
